intended_population: timing-attack CVEs in the NVD, March 2003 to December 2022 (Kholoosi, Babar and Yilmaz, arXiv 2308.11862), plus the constant-time literature since
warning: A seed census makes coverage look better than it is. Any coverage figure derived from this file must carry census_status beside it.
status_note: Expanded from the 7-entry seed to a broader, verified enumeration across the facet space (padding oracles, cache-set, statistical, cross-era). It is 'expanded', NOT 'complete': a truly complete census would enumerate the full NVD timing-CVE record (Kholoosi et al., arXiv 2308.11862), which is a larger undertaking. Because status is not 'complete', CLS-3 continues to withhold an aggregate headline recall figure; per-class recall is reported regardless. Completing the census would LOWER coverage (more attested cells), which is the honest direction.
